sentence_stem: If I had studied medicine at university,
correct_completion: I would be working as a doctor now.
full_sentence: If I had studied medicine at university, I would be working as a doctor now.
acceptable_variants: I would be a doctor today.
I would have a medical career now.

options.text: I will be working as a doctor now.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future possibility, not an imagined past condition with a present result.

options.text: I would be working as a doctor now.

options.why_wrong: This states a fact and does not give the present result of the imagined past condition.

options.text: I would have worked as a doctor last year.
options.why_wrong: The time reference 'last year' conflicts with the present result that the mixed conditional expresses.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: a past unreal condition with a present result
explanation: The if-clause refers to an unreal past situation, so it takes the past perfect. The main clause refers to the present result, so it takes 'would' with a continuous infinitive.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado medicina na universidade, eu estaria trabalhando como médico agora.
